name: analyzr-integrate
description: Interactive skills that bring customer process landscapes from Signavio, ARIS, Visio & co. into analyzr: /analyzr-integrate:integrate-landscape <export> [--workspace <dir>] inspects an export, normalizes BPMN 2.0, keeps model keys stable in the consultant's workspace (rebuilt from analyzr when lost), writes an import bundle, previews its import read-only and writes a German report. The consultant runs the import. Needs a shell and Node 24.
